5: /-!
6: # Canto finito dos Three Locks   [KERNEL/UNCONDITIONAL, DIMENSAO FINITA]
7: 
8: `H3L = Dc* Dc + Db* Db + Dz* Dz` em `EuclideanSpace ℂ (Fin n)`.
9: Provado: auto-adjunto; forma quadratica `= ‖Dc x‖²+‖Db x‖²+‖Dz x‖²`; positivo
10: semidefinido; `ker H3L = ker Dc ⊓ ker Db ⊓ ker Dz`. Traco normalizado do canto e
11: das faces como razao de dimensoes (`tau_F(P_F)=1`, faces `=1/2`).
12: 
13: ESTE E' UM TEOREMA FINITO-DIMENSIONAL. NAO E' UMA PROVA DE FATOR TIPO III_1.
14: 
15: NOTA: o projetor ortogonal explicito `P_F` entra num segundo passo (a API de
16: projecao ortogonal foi renomeada nesta mathlib; ver `TGL/Probe.lean`). O nucleo
17: do teorema -- PSD e `ker = interseccao` -- nao depende dele.
18: -/
19: 
20: namespace TGL.FiniteThreeLocks
21: 
22: variable {n : ℕ}
23: variable (Dc Db Dz : EuclideanSpace ℂ (Fin n) →ₗ[ℂ] EuclideanSpace ℂ (Fin n))
24: 
25: /-- O operador dos Three Locks: soma de tres `D_i^* D_i`. -/
26: noncomputable def H3L : EuclideanSpace ℂ (Fin n) →ₗ[ℂ] EuclideanSpace ℂ (Fin n) :=
27:   LinearMap.adjoint Dc ∘ₗ Dc + LinearMap.adjoint Db ∘ₗ Db + LinearMap.adjoint Dz ∘ₗ Dz
28: 
29: /-- Cada `D^* D` e' auto-adjunto. -/
30: theorem isSelfAdjoint_adjoint_comp_self
31:     (D : EuclideanSpace ℂ (Fin n) →ₗ[ℂ] EuclideanSpace ℂ (Fin n)) :
32:     IsSelfAdjoint (LinearMap.adjoint D ∘ₗ D) := by
33:   rw [IsSelfAdjoint, LinearMap.star_eq_adjoint, LinearMap.adjoint_comp,
34:       LinearMap.adjoint_adjoint]
35: 
36: /-- `H3L` e' auto-adjunto. -/
37: theorem H3L_isSelfAdjoint : IsSelfAdjoint (H3L Dc Db Dz) := by
38:   unfold H3L
39:   exact ((isSelfAdjoint_adjoint_comp_self Dc).add
40:           (isSelfAdjoint_adjoint_comp_self Db)).add
41:           (isSelfAdjoint_adjoint_comp_self Dz)
42: 
43: /-- Forma quadratica: `⟪x, H3L x⟫ = ‖Dc x‖² + ‖Db x‖² + ‖Dz x‖²`. -/
44: theorem H3L_quadratic_form (x : EuclideanSpace ℂ (Fin n)) :
45:     RCLike.re (inner ℂ x (H3L Dc Db Dz x))
46:       = ‖Dc x‖ ^ 2 + ‖Db x‖ ^ 2 + ‖Dz x‖ ^ 2 := by
47:   unfold H3L
48:   simp only [LinearMap.add_apply, LinearMap.comp_apply, inner_add_right,
49:              LinearMap.adjoint_inner_right, map_add, inner_self_eq_norm_sq]
50: 
51: /-- `H3L` e' positivo semidefinido: `Re ⟪x, H3L x⟫ ≥ 0`. -/
52: theorem H3L_posSemidefinite (x : EuclideanSpace ℂ (Fin n)) :
53:     0 ≤ RCLike.re (inner ℂ x (H3L Dc Db Dz x)) := by
54:   rw [H3L_quadratic_form]
55:   positivity
56: 
57: /-- `x ∈ ker H3L ↔ Dc x = 0 ∧ Db x = 0 ∧ Dz x = 0`. -/
58: theorem mem_ker_H3L_iff (x : EuclideanSpace ℂ (Fin n)) :
59:     x ∈ LinearMap.ker (H3L Dc Db Dz) ↔ Dc x = 0 ∧ Db x = 0 ∧ Dz x = 0 := by
60:   constructor
61:   · intro hx
62:     rw [LinearMap.mem_ker] at hx
63:     have hre : ‖Dc x‖ ^ 2 + ‖Db x‖ ^ 2 + ‖Dz x‖ ^ 2 = 0 := by
64:       rw [← H3L_quadratic_form Dc Db Dz x, hx, inner_zero_right, map_zero]
65:     refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩ <;> rw [← norm_eq_zero] <;>
66:       nlinarith [norm_nonneg (Dc x), norm_nonneg (Db x), norm_nonneg (Dz x),
67:         sq_nonneg (‖Dc x‖), sq_nonneg (‖Db x‖), sq_nonneg (‖Dz x‖)]
68:   · rintro ⟨hc, hb, hz⟩
69:     rw [LinearMap.mem_ker]
70:     simp [H3L, LinearMap.add_apply, LinearMap.comp_apply, hc, hb, hz]
71: 
72: /-- `ker H3L = ker Dc ⊓ ker Db ⊓ ker Dz` (a interseccao dos Three Locks). -/
73: theorem ker_H3L_eq_threeLocks :
74:     LinearMap.ker (H3L Dc Db Dz)
75:       = LinearMap.ker Dc ⊓ LinearMap.ker Db ⊓ LinearMap.ker Dz := by
76:   ext x
77:   rw [mem_ker_H3L_iff]
78:   simp only [Submodule.mem_inf, LinearMap.mem_ker, and_assoc]
79: 
80: /-- Projetor ortogonal sobre `ker H3L` -- o canto dos Three Locks.
81:     (`Submodule.starProjection` e' a projecao ortogonal como endomorfismo.) -/
82: noncomputable def PF : EuclideanSpace ℂ (Fin n) →L[ℂ] EuclideanSpace ℂ (Fin n) :=
83:   (LinearMap.ker (H3L Dc Db Dz)).starProjection
84: 
85: /-- `P_F` e' idempotente: `P_F ∘ P_F = P_F`. -/
86: theorem PF_isProjection : IsIdempotentElem (PF Dc Db Dz) :=
87:   Submodule.isIdempotentElem_starProjection _
88: 
89: /-- A imagem de `P_F` esta no canto: `P_F x ∈ ker H3L`. -/
90: theorem PF_apply_mem (x : EuclideanSpace ℂ (Fin n)) :
91:     PF Dc Db Dz x ∈ LinearMap.ker (H3L Dc Db Dz) :=
92:   Submodule.starProjection_apply_mem _ x
93: 
94: /-- `P_F` e' auto-adjunto: `⟪P_F u, v⟫ = ⟪u, P_F v⟫`. -/
95: theorem PF_isSelfAdjoint (u v : EuclideanSpace ℂ (Fin n)) :
96:     inner ℂ (PF Dc Db Dz u) v = inner ℂ u (PF Dc Db Dz v) :=
97:   Submodule.inner_starProjection_left_eq_right _ u v
98: 
99: /-- `P_F` fixa exatamente o canto: `P_F v = v ↔ v ∈ ker H3L`. -/
100: theorem PF_eq_self_iff (v : EuclideanSpace ℂ (Fin n)) :
101:     PF Dc Db Dz v = v ↔ v ∈ LinearMap.ker (H3L Dc Db Dz) :=
102:   Submodule.starProjection_eq_self_iff
103: 
104: /-- Dimensao do canto (nucleo de `H3L`). -/
105: noncomputable def cornerDim : ℕ := Module.finrank ℂ (LinearMap.ker (H3L Dc Db Dz))
106: 
107: /-- `tau_F(P_F) = 1`: `Tr_F(P_F) = dim F`, logo `dim F / dim F = 1` (canto nao-trivial). -/
108: theorem normalizedCornerTrace_PF (h : 0 < cornerDim Dc Db Dz) :
109:     (cornerDim Dc Db Dz : ℝ) / (cornerDim Dc Db Dz : ℝ) = 1 := by
110:   have hne : (cornerDim Dc Db Dz : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast h.ne'
111:   exact div_self hne
112: 
113: /-- Faces conjugadas iguais tem traco normalizado `1/2`. -/
114: theorem equalConjugateFaces_halfTrace
115:     (dplus dminus : ℕ)
116:     (hsplit : dplus + dminus = cornerDim Dc Db Dz)
117:     (heq : dplus = dminus) (hpos : 0 < cornerDim Dc Db Dz) :
118:     (dplus : ℝ) / (cornerDim Dc Db Dz : ℝ) = 1 / 2 := by
119:   have hcd : cornerDim Dc Db Dz = 2 * dplus := by omega
120:   have hcdR : (cornerDim Dc Db Dz : ℝ) = 2 * (dplus : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hcd
121:   have hdpos : 0 < dplus := by omega
122:   have hdne : ((dplus : ℝ)) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast hdpos.ne'
123:   have h2d : (2 * (dplus : ℝ)) ≠ 0 := mul_ne_zero (by norm_num) hdne
124:   rw [hcdR, div_eq_div_iff h2d (by norm_num : (2 : ℝ) ≠ 0)]
125:   ring
126: 
127: end TGL.FiniteThreeLocks
